kind: supplemental finite label control, completed native receipt
scope: Public ordinary frame jumps at pc24 to32. Private four-slot flags1 frame without DefPrm jumps at same pc24 to32. Only its label target changes from the zero-label control. Falling through pc24 would return sentinel Const[1]=23. Wrapper forwards the actual private return through opcode5/0 followed by17/0, without reading an uninitialized local. Both entries are intended to terminate; no original application code is executed. This does not establish original flags2 procedure behavior.

measurement.interpretation: Both controls forward the private result correctly and return7. This does not distinguish zero-address routing from a fallback to the public nonzero label; use the later three-path controls for that question.
